C0443.title: Enumeration Attack Definition and Payment Card Cracking Mechanism
C0443.summary: An enumeration attack, also known as card testing or card cracking, occurs when fraudsters use automated scripts or bots to submit numerous small-value transactions to merchant payment gateways.
